name: Nano Empire AI
description: Signed behavioral proof of agent skills and MCP servers (SkillProof), plus metered machine APIs (RecallGuard recall data) priced for HTTP 402 / USDC settlement. Discovery only: A2A task endpoint not implemented; call the REST APIs in https://nanoempireai.com/openapi.json. Unsigned card. paper_mode: true, no paid machine transaction verified as of 2026-09-27. Server order: 1) https://recallguard-api.vercel.app (primary RecallGuard, HTTPS, open); 2) 147.5.105.20 port 8420 (secondary RecallGuard, plain HTTP, DEBUG, x402 configured, 100 free calls); 3) 147.5.105.20 port 8405 (SkillProof quote box, plain HTTP); 4) api.nanoempireai.com (/v1/* not deployed, 404, as of 2026-09-27). Flow: discover, free calls, 402, receipt.

skills.name: RecallGuard feed
skills.description: Normalized US recall records (CPSC consumer products; openFDA food, drug, device). 21,812 records on the primary server as of 2026-09-27 (2023-01-04 to 2026-09-24). Primary: GET https://recallguard-api.vercel.app/api/v1/feed (open). Secondary: GET http://147.5.105.20:8420/v1/feed (100 free calls, then x402; older, smaller dataset snapshot). Price: 0.05 USDC per call via x402 (offers.json). Status: available (paper mode, no paid receipt).

skills.name: RecallGuard match
skills.description: Match a product inventory (name, brand, UPC) against the recall set; returns hits with a score. Primary: POST https://recallguard-api.vercel.app/api/v1/match with {"items":[...]} (open). Secondary: POST http://147.5.105.20:8420/v1/match with {"inventory":[...]} (100 free calls, then x402). Price: 0.1 USDC per call via x402 (offers.json). Status: available (paper mode, no paid receipt).

skills.name: IRV advisory
skills.description: Signed incident-response verification advisory for a single incident. Status: building (no public endpoint returns 200 as of 2026-09-27). Price when available: 500.0 USDC per advisory via x402 (offers.json).

skills.name: IRV feed

skills.name: SkillProof
